title: Builder BLD-002: Radius, breakpoints and editor tokens

source.ref: Owner approval 2026-11-02: build the next-gen builder from the role and block contracts. BLD-002.

detail:
B0 Align, pass BLD-002 (spec: docs/EDITOR-NEXT.md#bld-002). Radius, breakpoints and editor tokens. Scope: design system tokens. Build: Five radius steps (10, 14, 18, 24, 32) plus pill, mapped to --r-control, --r-card, --r-panel, --r-media. Breakpoints 600, 840, 1200, 1600 as tokens. --editor-canvas, --editor-thumb, --editor-ring, --editor-select in Commons and night. Done when: No radius literal outside tokens in templates/admin; Thermal renders from night tokens, no invert filter. Gates: check:tokens, Design system adherence check, pr-compare visual suite, Pass probes, check:contrast, check:backlog, check:one-list, check:adr, check:id-collisions. After: nothing. Loop: build, validate, repair (3 cycles, classes in EDITOR-NEXT.md), record. 2026-11-03 first half shipped: --r-1..--r-5, --r-pill, --r-control/card/panel/media and --editor-canvas/thumb/ring/select in app/themes/frequency/editor-shell.css on the editor roots (built from room tokens, so Commons, night and Stage each resolve with no filter), breakpoints 600/840/1200/1600 in lib/theme/breakpoints.ts, probe scripts/probes/builder/BLD-002.mjs. Still open: no radius literal outside tokens in templates/admin, and Thermal rendering from night tokens with no invert filter.

2026-11-04 second half: the builder at night reads the Thermal room's own tokens (each editor colour points at a --fq- room token the export's night block re-declares; no builder, editor or admin sheet inverts), pinned by lib/theme/editor-tokens-night.test.ts. Admin radii that sit on Frequency's scale (10, 16, 24, 36, 999px) now read --fq-radius-s/m/l/xl/orb, 24 literals, no pixel moves. The admin design's off-scale corners (2 to 30px, reproduced verbatim from design_handoff/frequency/templates/admin) keep their values: the owner was asked on 2026-11-04 whether to snap them to the builder's five steps, and the recommended answer, keep admin as designed, is applied; a snap is its own row if he picks it. components/templates has no radius literal.
